parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end timestamp of the data, in seconds. Example: 1684166400. If this parameter is not specified, the current time is used by default.

parameters.name: MetricType
parameters.description:
The metric type. Valid values:

- 0: basic task information.
- 1: task execution information.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for special third-party integrations.

parameters.name: Operate
parameters.description:
The operation type. Valid values:

- query: queries interval data.
- query_range: queries interval time series data.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start timestamp of the data, in seconds. Example: 1684166400.
